jobs.title: Early Careers: Junior C#/SQL Developer & Data Analytics
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Early Careers: Junior C#/ SQL Developer & Data Analytics**

Are you curious about the Insurance industry? Interested in working with a team of experts who are generous with sharing their knowledge, and joining an industry leading, highly inclusive organization? This could be the perfect opportunity for you!

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Montreal office.

**Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.**

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

* Maintaining and enhancing our in‑house applications built primarily with C#, .NET and Microsoft SQL Server, including adding new features, improving usability, and solving bugs raised by users.
* Fulfilling ad‑hoc data requests from colleagues by writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract, validate and format information from our systems for business, operational and reporting needs.
* Building and supporting automation solutions (mail merge, Excel macros, C# utilities and SQL Server scripts) that streamline office workflows and improve efficiency.
* Acting as a liaison between business users and Aon IT, helping to translate user requirements into technical requests (e.g., application changes, folder or network access, permission updates).
* Partnering with Aon IT teams to coordinate and test system upgrades, patches and infrastructure changes, ensuring our C#/.NET and SQL Server–based applications remain stable and available with minimal downtime.
* Developing and maintaining business reports (for example, attendance and other key performance or operational reports) using tools such as Crystal Reports, Excel and SQL Server.
* Documenting changes, processes and user guides to support knowledge transfer and provide clear references for both technical teams and non‑technical users.
* Participating in regular team meetings to discuss priorities, review upcoming work, and contribute ideas for improving our systems and processes

**How this opportunity is different**

This role provides an opportunity to observe the full lifecycle of internal tools and applications, from understanding end‑user needs through composing, build, testing, deployment and ongoing support. You will have direct contact with business users, giving you a clear view of how your work improves efficiency and supports critical day‑to‑day operations. You will be working for a business unit supporting high profile clients in the professional services industries, operating in multiple insurance markets (US, UK, Bermuda, Canada) and will have the chance to interact with people from all those locations.

We are a small team, you will gain broad, hands‑on experience across application development, data/reporting, automation and basic infrastructure coordination rather than being limited to a narrow specialization. You will work closely with experienced colleagues in both the business and Aon IT, with opportunities for mentorship, on‑the‑job learning and exposure to enterprise‑grade tools and environments.

The systems you support are important to our business; you will quickly see the impact of your work and be encouraged to propose and implement improvements.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

  

* Recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Software engineering, Computer science, Programming specialization, Information technology specialization, Systems Administration, or a relevant field;
* Hands‑on experience with C# (preferably using WPF) in Visual Studio, including building and debugging desktop applications (academic, internship, or professional);
* Understanding of object‑oriented programming and development protocols;
* Solid understanding of SQL, with a strong preference for Microsoft SQL Server (writing queries, joins, basic performance tuning, and simple stored procedures);
* Experience with Microsoft Access for database queries, table design, and relationships
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for basic web pages and user interfaces
* Strong Excel skills (formulas, functions, sorting/filtering)
* Experience integrating C# applications with Microsoft Office (e.g., Excel, Outlook, Word) programmatically is an asset
* Basic understanding of SharePoint
* Experience with Kentico or Sitecore is an asset
* Good interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and written;
* French / English bilingualism required due to frequent interactions with clients, colleagues, or partners based in Quebec, other Canadian provinces and/or internationally.
* High discernment and professional presentation skills.

***Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.***

#AonLaunchCanada

#LI-KT2

jobs.title: Software Developer Coop
jobs.description:
**À propos de ce poste**

  

**Role description**

As an **intern within the Developer Platform team** , you may contribute to different types of initiatives related to agentic AI, automation, development platforms, and the improvement of software engineering practices, depending on current priorities and the squad you are assigned to. The specific mandate will be confirmed later, but may include:

* Contribute to the exploration, prototyping, or integration of agentic AI solutions that support developers in their day-to-day activities, such as understanding code, automating tasks, analyzing pipelines, or helping resolve issues.
* Participate in improving the developer experience by simplifying the practices, tools, and processes used daily by software teams.
* Contribute to intelligent engineering initiatives, including collecting, analyzing, or visualizing data to better understand engineering performance and identify opportunities for AI-assisted support.
* Help automate recurring operational processes to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and accelerate platform adoption at scale.
* Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices, or secure delivery mechanisms that may integrate AI-assisted analysis, recommendation, or automation capabilities.
* Participate in work related to development, integration, deployment, or operations platforms, including cloud, containerized, or automated environments.
* Collaborate with engineers, architects, and product owners to understand team needs and propose practical improvements.
* Explore and prototype solutions that improve the productivity, quality, security, visibility, or actionability of software development teams.

**Candidate profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Passionate** about technology and automation.
* **Curious** , with an interest in learning and experimenting.
* **Proactive** , able to take initiative.
* **Strong in problem-solving** , with a logical and creative approach.

**Desired technical skills:**

* Currently enrolled in a university or college program in software engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related field.
* Previous hands-on exposure to software development concepts and at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, PowerShell, or Bash, through coursework, labs, personal projects, or internships.
* Basic practical experience with CI/CD, DevOps, software development platforms, or collaborative development tools such as Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, or Jira.
* Some exposure to automation, scripting, integrations, APIs, or operational improvements that reduce manual work and improve developer productivity.
* Exposure to cloud, container, or infrastructure concepts through coursework, labs, personal projects, or previous internships.
* Familiarity, even at an introductory level, with technologies such as Kubernetes/OpenShift, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Copilot, Azure, Artifactory, ArgoCD, or similar platform engineering tools.
* Basic awareness or prior exposure to AI-assisted software development, software quality, cybersecurity, and modern platform engineering practices.

**À propos de CAE**
===================

*À CAE, notre mission est claire : contribuer à rendre le monde plus sécuritaire. Depuis près de 80 ans, nous faisons progresser l’innovation en simulation, en formation et en préparation aux missions afin de soutenir des opérations critiques partout dans le monde. Grâce à des technologies avancées, nous aidons nos clients à travailler plus intelligemment, plus rapidement et de façon plus durable. Joignez‑vous à une organisation guidée par sa raison d’être, où les idées audacieuses sont encouragées, où la collaboration fait avancer les choses et où votre développement alimente notre réussite commune.*

**Type d'emploi**
=================

Étudiant COOp (Fixed Term)

**Égalité des chances et mesures d’adaptation**
===============================================

*CAE s’engage à offrir des chances égales à tous les candidats, sans égard à la race, à la nationalité, à la couleur, à la religion, au sexe, à l’identité ou à l’expression de genre, à l’orientation sexuelle, au handicap, à la neurodiversité, au statut d’ancien combattant, à l’âge ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Nous encourageons les personnes qui ne répondent pas à tous les critères à poser leur candidature. Des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables sont offertes au besoin — communiquez avec votre recruteur ou écrivez à* *CAECarrieres‑Careers@cae.com* *.*

**Protection des données**
==========================

Déclaration de confidentialité

*Nous utilisons parfois des outils appuyés par l’IA pour soutenir l’évaluation des candidatures, tout en gardant une prise de décision entièrement humaine. CAE remercie tous les candidats de leur intérêt. Toutefois, seules les personnes dont le profil et l’expérience répondent aux exigences du poste seront contactées.*

* OpenAI GPT Models.

**Database & Integration**

* Stored Procedures (SPs).
* Views.

* API Integration and Development.

* Python for AI integrations.

Pay: $120,000.00-$150,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
RAM Consulting is a Canadian project delivery firm supporting some of North America’s most complex and impactful infrastructure projects. We specialize in engineering, project and construction management, and project support services across the marine, transportation, utilities, infrastructure, and energy sectors.
  
  
Our clients trust us to help deliver critical infrastructure that builds communities, supports economic growth, and improves everyday life. Everything we do is guided by a commitment to safety, integrity, and sustainability.
  
  
What sets RAM apart is our people. Our team brings diverse experience from owner, contractor, and consulting environments, giving us a practical, solutions-focused perspective at every stage of the project lifecycle. From early planning through to delivery, we work collaboratively with our clients and partners to get projects done right.
  
  
About the Role
  
RAM is looking for a Software Engineer I to join our growing technology team. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career Software Engineer who already has some professional development experience and is looking to continue building their skills across full-stack development, cloud technology, data integration, and AI.
  
  
Working under the guidance of a Senior Engineer, Lead, or IT Manager, you will contribute to both internal RAM solutions and client-facing projects. You’ll work primarily within a modern Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS environment while gaining further exposure to Python, databases, data integration, and emerging AI technologies.
  
  
We’re looking for someone with approximately 1–2+ years of practical software development experience who understands modern development workflows and is comfortable contributing within a collaborative engineering environment.
  
  
What You’ll Be Working On
  

* Develop full-stack features using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.
* Build user interface components, REST APIs, and integrations following established development standards.
* Write clean, maintainable and testable code, including unit and basic integration testing.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior team members.
* Work with Git, branches, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, views, and stored procedures using relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Build simple ETL jobs and system integrations using Node.js or Python.
* Support data migration activities including data mapping, clean-up scripts and validation.
* Prepare and structure data for reporting and dashboards, including Power BI.
* Build and support simple AI and Large Language Model (LLM) features using platforms such as Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock or Azure OpenAI.
* Assist with prompt development, testing and improvement of AI-generated outputs.
* Support Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including document loading, chunking, embeddings and search.
* Use approved AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot while reviewing and validating AI-generated code.
* Support minor changes within existing C#/.NET applications when required.
* Assist with simple Microsoft-based automations using tools such as Power Automate, SharePoint and Microsoft Graph API.
* Follow secure coding practices including OWASP principles, secrets management and safe API handling.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and maintain project work within Jira.
* Contribute to both internal RAM initiatives and billable client projects, including potential assignments directly with RAM clients.

What We’re Looking For
  

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 1–2+ years of professional software development experience; relevant co-op or internship experience may be considered.
* Practical development experience with Node.js, TypeScript and React.
* Good SQL skills and experience working with at least one relational database.
* Basic experience with Python and C#/.NET.
* Experience using Git and CI/CD pipelines within a team development environment.
* Basic cloud experience, ideally within AWS; Azure exposure is considered an asset.
* Familiarity with AWS technologies such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, RDS, DynamoDB and IAM is beneficial.
* Exposure to LLM APIs or AI development, whether through professional, academic or personal projects.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON and modern web development practices.
* Familiarity with automated testing tools such as Jest or Vitest and basic Docker concepts.
* ETL, data migration, Power BI or Power Automate experience is considered an asset.
* Exposure to RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering or other AI development concepts is an asset.
* Familiarity with Acumatica customization is considered an asset but is not required.
* Strong communication, problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Curious and motivated to continue learning, particularly within AI, cloud and data technologies.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of assigned work.

Compensation & Benefits
  
The estimated annual base salary for this position is $60,000 - $70,000 as of the posting date. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, education, and training.
  
  
Please note that this range reflects base pay only and does not include the competitive bonus program or the comprehensive benefits package offered by RAM Consulting. RAM provides a strong total rewards package including extended health and dental coverage, paid vacation and sick time, statutory holidays, annual performance and salary reviews, tuition reimbursement, and career development opportunities.
  
  
Why You Should Join RAM
  

* Ability to work on North America’s largest projects
* Be part of an innovativ

jobs.title: Associate, Software Engineer, New Grad
jobs.description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Associate, Software Engineer, New Grad

MUST INCLUDE YOUR RESUME AND UNOFFICIAL TRANSCRIPT IN ONE PDF DOCUMENT IN THE ATTACHMENT SECTION WHEN YOU CREATE YOUR PROFILE TO APPLY.

### **About Capital One Canada**

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

You’ll be empowered to grow your career in a supportive environment where you can own and shape your journey on your own terms. You’ll redefine what’s possible by contributing to work that impacts millions of Canadians, taking ownership of your decisions and outcomes, supported by mentors who will push you to think bigger and challenge the status quo.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

### **About the Team**

Yes, we’re a credit card company. But we’re more than that too. We’re driven by what our customers want, and how to make their lives simpler.

We’re always looking for creative ways to offer digital solutions that make sense for our customers. With your help, we’ll build the next generation of banking in Canada based on customer-focused values, compelling products and great engineering.

### **About the Role**

Our environment is creative, filled with teams that are passionate about the work they're doing and the people they are doing it for. We're a technology thought leader in the financial industry and we want to keep it that way.

We have a passion for open-source and for working with the latest technologies. Whether you're a big Apple fan or an Android lover, a UI developer or prefer NoSQL databases over anything else, you'll fit in our team. All you need is to be passionate about technology!

Below are some of the skills the team is looking for, but you’re not expected to have them all. Curiosity and willingness to learn are what matter most.

* IDE: Android Studio, XCode, Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ
* Language: Kotlin, Swift, Javascript, Typescript, GoLang, NodeJS
* AWS: S3, EC2, Lambda, Route53, Security Groups, IAM roles
* Monitoring Tool: Splunk, New Relic, Cloudwatch
* Testing Framework: MockitoJUnitRunner, Espresso, XCTest

Our Associates are involved in business critical projects. Here are some examples.

* Improve user experience for Android / iOS customers
* Develop CI/CD pipelines to AWS cloud environment
* Remediate and enhance cyber security
* Create front end applications with React and Angular.
* Develop backend Microservice applications and APIs

Think it. Code it.

This is our motto! By that, we mean that you, as a member of one of our great Agile teams will be responsible for the design, coding, testing and delivery of solutions that benefit our customers and Canadians in general.

### **Continuous Learning**

We’re here to help you develop your knowledge and skills, both on the job and in the classroom. Our engineers have access to incredible continuous learning tools and courses through our very own Tech College, a world-class learning hub that offers both online and in-person classes for across multiple disciplines—Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Mobile Development, Machine Learning & AI, to name a few.

As a new Software Engineer, you’ll join the Tech Development Program (TDP), which takes place over your first year with us and involves hands-on learning, development, and networking. Throughout your time in the program you could tackle front-end, back-end, full-stack, mobile development, or maybe even all of them.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Work as part of a dynamic team throughout the software development life cycle
* Collaborate with designers and analysts to implement enhancements or new applications
* Develop code to meet story acceptance criteria
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure high-level quality output
* Ensure adherence to continuous improvement practices as required to meet quality, and time to market imperatives
* Maintain records to document program development, and revisions
* Provide third-level support of software solution as needed

Basic Qualifications:

* Have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or higher between September 2025 to September 2026
* Good communication, presentation, and writing skills
* Good understanding of testing fundamentals
* Experience in unix or linux operating systems
* Able to work within a team setting and actively participate and collaborate in team discussions

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in front end development such as JavaScript, HTML, mobile, frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular
* Knowledge of programming languages, including but not limited to Java, Python, JavaScript, NodeJS, Kotlin.
* Experience with Jenkins CI/CD, microservices, API design / integration
* Experience with version control technology i.e. Git
* Experience in a Linux/Unix environment with strong coding background.

### **Working at Capital One**

Here you’ll uncover personal strengths, explore new interests and make an impact that matters. The work you’ll find here will keep you inspired and guide you in your career journey.

* Take ownership of your own potential: As you begin your career, you’ll define your own path by gaining exposure across the business, learning new skills, and having access to tools and mentorship to understand your potential.
* Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.
* Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in

RAM is looking for a Software Engineer I to join our growing technology team. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career Software Engineer who already has some professional development experience and is looking to continue building their skills across full-stack development, cloud technology, data integration, and AI.
  
  
Working under the guidance of a Senior Engineer, Lead, or IT Manager, you will contribute to both internal RAM solutions and client-facing projects. You’ll work primarily within a modern Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS environment while gaining further exposure to Python, databases, data integration, and emerging AI technologies.

* Work with Git, branches, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, views, and stored procedures using relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Build simple ETL jobs and system integrations using Node.js or Python.
* Support data migration activities including data mapping, clean-up scripts and validation.

* Support minor changes within existing C#/.NET applications when required.
* Assist with simple Microsoft-based automations using tools such as Power Automate, SharePoint and Microsoft Graph API.
* Follow secure coding practices including OWASP principles, secrets management and safe API handling.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and maintain project work within Jira.
* Contribute to both internal RAM initiatives and billable client projects, including potential assignments directly with RAM clients.

What We’re Looking For
  

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Practical development experience with Node.js, TypeScript and React.
* Good SQL skills and experience working with at least one relational database.
* Basic experience with Python and C#/.NET.
* Experience using Git and CI/CD pipelines within a team development environment.
* Basic cloud experience, ideally within AWS; Azure exposure is considered an asset.
* Familiarity with AWS technologies such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, RDS, DynamoDB and IAM is beneficial.
* Exposure to LLM APIs or AI development, whether through professional, academic or personal projects.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON and modern web development practices.
* Familiarity with automated testing tools such as Jest or Vitest and basic Docker concepts.
* ETL, data migration, Power BI or Power Automate experience is considered an asset.
* Exposure to RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering or other AI development concepts is an asset.
* Familiarity with Acumatica customization is considered an asset but is not required.
* Strong communication, problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Curious and motivated to continue learning, particularly within AI, cloud and data technologies.
* Able to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of assigned work.

Compensation & Benefits
  
The estimated annual base salary for this position is $60,000 - $70,000 as of the posting date. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, education, and training.

### **About Capital One Canada**

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

You’ll be empowered to grow your career in a supportive environment where you can own and shape your journey on your own terms. You’ll redefine what’s possible by contributing to work that impacts millions of Canadians, taking ownership of your decisions and outcomes, supported by mentors who will push you to think bigger and challenge the status quo.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

### **About the Team**

Yes, we’re a credit card company. But we’re more than that too. We’re driven by what our customers want, and how to make their lives simpler.

We’re always looking for creative ways to offer digital solutions that make sense for our customers. With your help, we’ll build the next generation of banking in Canada based on customer-focused values, compelling products and great engineering.

### **About the Role**

Our environment is creative, filled with teams that are passionate about the work they're doing and the people they are doing it for. We're a technology thought leader in the financial industry and we want to keep it that way.

We have a passion for open-source and for working with the latest technologies. Whether you're a big Apple fan or an Android lover, a UI developer or prefer NoSQL databases over anything else, you'll fit in our team. All you need is to be passionate about technology!

Below are some of the skills the team is looking for, but you’re not expected to have them all. Curiosity and willingness to learn are what matter most.

* IDE: Android Studio, XCode, Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ
* Language: Kotlin, Swift, Javascript, Typescript, GoLang, NodeJS
* AWS: S3, EC2, Lambda, Route53, Security Groups, IAM roles
* Monitoring Tool: Splunk, New Relic, Cloudwatch
* Testing Framework: MockitoJUnitRunner, Espresso, XCTest

Our Associates are involved in business critical projects. Here are some examples.

* Improve user experience for Android / iOS customers
* Develop CI/CD pipelines to AWS cloud environment
* Remediate and enhance cyber security
* Create front end applications with React and Angular.
* Develop backend Microservice applications and APIs

Think it. Code it.

This is our motto! By that, we mean that you, as a member of one of our great Agile teams will be responsible for the design, coding, testing and delivery of solutions that benefit our customers and Canadians in general.

### **Continuous Learning**

We’re here to help you develop your knowledge and skills, both on the job and in the classroom. Our engineers have access to incredible continuous learning tools and courses through our very own Tech College, a world-class learning hub that offers both online and in-person classes for across multiple disciplines—Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Mobile Development, Machine Learning & AI, to name a few.

As a new Software Engineer, you’ll join the Tech Development Program (TDP), which takes place over your first year with us and involves hands-on learning, development, and networking. Throughout your time in the program you could tackle front-end, back-end, full-stack, mobile development, or maybe even all of them.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Work as part of a dynamic team throughout the software development life cycle
* Collaborate with designers and analysts to implement enhancements or new applications
* Develop code to meet story acceptance criteria
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure high-level quality output
* Ensure adherence to continuous improvement practices as required to meet quality, and time to market imperatives
* Maintain records to document program development, and revisions
* Provide third-level support of software solution as needed

Basic Qualifications:

* Have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or higher between September 2025 to September 2026
* Good communication, presentation, and writing skills
* Good understanding of testing fundamentals
* Experience in unix or linux operating systems
* Able to work within a team setting and actively participate and collaborate in team discussions

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in front end development such as JavaScript, HTML, mobile, frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular
* Knowledge of programming languages, including but not limited to Java, Python, JavaScript, NodeJS, Kotlin.
* Experience with Jenkins CI/CD, microservices, API design / integration
* Experience with version control technology i.e. Git
* Experience in a Linux/Unix environment with strong coding background.

### **Working at Capital One**

Here you’ll uncover personal strengths, explore new interests and make an impact that matters. The work you’ll find here will keep you inspired and guide you in your career journey.

* Take ownership of your own potential: As you begin your career, you’ll define your own path by gaining exposure across the business, learning new skills, and having access to tools and mentorship to understand your potential.
* Find your rhythm: We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.
* Benefits built for your life: We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in
